description: This file contains code to seed a database with roles, skills, and their associations for a career pathway navigation system. It defines functions to create or fetch roles and skills, attach skills to roles with specified levels, compute gap annotations, and seed baseline data, including example progress. The focus is on initializing and managing the seed dataset for the application's database.

methods.name: List[Skill] _ensure_skills(skill_repo: SkillRepository, specs: List[Tuple[str, str, str]])
methods.description: Creates or fetches skills by name based on a list of specifications.

methods.name: None _attach_role_skills( role_repo: RoleRepository, rec_repo: RecommendationRepository, role_name: str, role_skill_levels: Dict[str, int], target_role_levels: Dict[str, int] | None = None, )
methods.description: Attaches skills to a role with specified levels, computes and enforces gap annotations, and adds optional recommendations.

methods.name: None seed_minimal_dataset(session: Session)
methods.description: Seeds the database with a baseline set of roles, skills, and their associations, including sample progress data.

methods.name: None seed_minimal_dataset_idempotent(session: Session)
methods.description: Performs an idempotent seed of the dataset, ensuring all roles, skills, and links are present without duplication.
